description: Fix ESLint no-unused-vars warnings across the codebase (191 warnings in lib/, bin/, test/, scripts/) and enable strict linting with --max-warnings 0.
steps: 1. Updated ESLint config to use argsIgnorePattern, varsIgnorePattern, and caughtErrorsIgnorePattern for underscore-prefixed variables
2. Fixed all 191 no-unused-vars warnings by adding underscore prefix to genuinely unused variables
3. Removed unused imports across all files
4. Fixed catch blocks to use underscore prefix for unused error variables
5. Verified npm run lint:strict passes with zero warnings
6. Verified npm test passes all 1211 tests
acceptance_criteria: Running npm run lint produces zero warnings
All tests still pass after fixes (npm test)
No functionality is broken by removing unused variables/imports
verification: npm run lint:strict exits with code 0
findings: The codebase had 191 ESLint no-unused-vars warnings. Most were: (1) unused catch block parameters (error, e, err), (2) unused function parameters in base classes/interfaces, (3) unused imports. Fixed by: (1) Adding underscore prefix convention to ESLint config, (2) Adding underscore prefix to unused variables, (3) Removing unused imports that were never used.
